audience: DevOps and release engineers who host deb, rpm, gem and other packages on packagecloud

useCases.title: List repositories and what they hold
useCases.text: The AI lists your package repositories with privacy, package count and last push, and opens one. It can include repositories you collaborate on.

useCases.title: Find a package and list all its versions
useCases.text: The AI searches a repository by package file name, filtered by type, distribution or architecture, then lists the versions of one package name.

useCases.title: Check download and install counts
useCases.text: The AI reads download statistics of a package version and install statistics of a repository, as a count or a time series, for a date range you set.

useCases.title: Look at package details, GPG keys and the README
useCases.text: The AI reads a package's size, checksums, dependencies and licenses, the signing keys of a repository, and its Markdown README.

useCases.title: Promote a package from staging to production
useCases.text: The AI moves a package file to another repository. It is gone from the source repository afterwards and its download stats are cleared.

useCases.title: Create repositories, write READMEs or delete package files
useCases.text: The AI creates an empty repository and creates or appends Markdown to a repository README. It can also delete a package file for good.
